cities.name: Bern
cities.local_food_tip: Swiss cheese dishes, fresh breads, hearty meals — ideal after walking historic alleys or river‑side strolls.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Explore the UNESCO‑listed old town — cobblestone streets, medieval towers and fountains. → ☕ Coffee & pastry in a charming café.

Afternoon: 🌳 Walk along the river or visit nearby nature spots — enjoy calm waters and green surroundings. → 🍽️ Lunch: Swiss comfort food, local dishes.

Sunset: 🌇 View from a hill or vantage point over old town and river for a scenic panorama.

Night: 🌃 Quiet dinner in a local restaurant, enjoy city lights and relaxed Swiss atmosphere.

ideas: 🌸 Blossoming trees around old town and river — nice for photos and walks.
🚶 Pleasant walking weather through narrow alleys and waterfront paths.
🍷 Try local dishes and Swiss specialties in cosy restaurants.
🌞 Relax by river, maybe swim or enjoy water‑side breeze (if weather allows).
🍨 Ice‑cream, light meals and calm summer strolls through old town.
🎶 Summer events, local festivals or city‑wide cultural happenings.
🍁 Foliage around river and old town — beautiful autumn light and ambience.
🥘 Hearty meals, warm drinks and cosy cafés after day walks.
🏛️ Indoor cultural visits if weather cools — museums or historic buildings.
❄️ Snow or frost on historic rooftops and riverbanks — fairytale‑like atmosphere.
🔥 Warm Swiss dishes, cheese fondue or soups after cold walks.
🌙 Evening strolls under winter lights — peaceful and scenic.

public_transport_tips: 🚶 Old town and central parts are walkable — best explored on foot.
🚌 Use local buses/trams to reach outskirts or nature spots if needed.
🚲 Short rides or bike paths helpful along river or city sides.
🎟️ Check city transport passes if staying multiple days.

city_events.name: Bern Summer & River Days
city_events.description: 🌿 Relax by river, local events and summer‑city vibe with Swiss charm.

cities.name: Interlaken & Alps Region
cities.local_food_tip: Hearty mountain meals — cheeses, breads, rustic dishes — perfect after hikes, lake outings or alpine walks.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏞️ Take boat ride on a nearby alpine lake or hike a mountain trail — enjoy fresh air and nature. → 🍽️ Lunch in a mountain‑village tavern.

Afternoon: 🚣 Explore lakes, valleys or take cable‑car/trail to panoramic viewpoints. → ☕ Relax with hot drink and local food after active day.

Sunset: 🌅 View of mountains, lakes or valleys at golden hour — unforgettable alpine sunset. 

Night: 🌙 Stay in mountain‑style guesthouse, enjoy calm night under stars and alpine atmosphere.

ideas: 🌿 Alpine meadows bloom, rivers run — ideal for hiking or early‑season nature walks.
🚣 Boat rides on lakes as weather warms up.
🥾 Light trekking and calm village‑time with fresh air.
🏞️ Hiking, lake swims or boat rides — full nature immersion under sun.
🌤️ Pleasant mountain weather — perfect for outdoor activities and relaxation.
🔥 Rustic dinners and mountain hospitality after active day.
🍂 Mountain forests and meadows turn colorful — stunning autumn views.
🥘 Hearty meals and cozy guesthouses after hikes or walks.
📷 Photography, calm walks and nature appreciation in quieter season.
❄️ Snowy trails, possible ski or snow‑walks — alpine winter magic.
🔥 Warm meals, fireplaces and cosy nights after cold outdoor time.
🌌 Clear starry skies and calm mountain nights — peaceful getaway.

public_transport_tips: 🚞 Use regional trains or mountain‑cable cars for easy access to high‑altitude spots.
🚶 Small villages and lakes often walkable — good for relaxed exploring.
🥾 Good hiking boots and proper gear recommended for mountain activities.
🎟️ Check seasonal passes for mountain transport and lake/boat access.

city_events.name: Alps Hiking & Nature Week
city_events.description: 🥾 Guided trails, lake tours, mountain‑village village visits and alpine nature events.
